errors.evidence: The description states the y-axis units are unknown, but the figure caption (not provided in the OCR but available in the paper) specifies "при база 2007 година" (with base year 2007), indicating the values are an index where 2007=100. The description should have noted this.
The description incorrectly identifies the markers for the 'БВП' (GDP) line as round ('кръгли'). The figure clearly shows they are diamond-shaped.

errors.text_span: Тя започва при стойност около 103 през 2007 година, спада до около 98 през 2008 година, след което се покачва до около 114 през 2009 година.
errors.evidence: The description of the 'БВП' (GDP) line is completely wrong for the first three years. The line starts at 100 in 2007 (the base year), rises to about 106 in 2008 (not falls to 98), and then falls to about 102 in 2009 (not rises to 114).

The description incorrectly identifies the markers for the 'Частни инвестиции' (Private investments) line as triangular ('триъгълни') and the line style as dotted ('пунктирана'). The figure shows square markers and a solid line.

errors.text_span: Тя започва при стойност около 124 през 2007 г., спада до около 105 през 2008 г. и достига около 114 през 2009 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the 'Частни инвестиции' (Private investments) line is incorrect. It starts at 100 in 2007 (not 124), rises to a peak of about 124 in 2008 (not falls to 105), and then falls to about 102 in 2009 (not 114).

The description incorrectly identifies the markers for the 'Публични инвестиции' (Public investments) line as square ('квадратни') and the line style as dotted ('пунктирана'). The figure shows triangular markers and a solid line.

errors.text_span: Тя започва при стойност около 100 през 2007 г., спада до около 75 през 2009 г., след което се повишава до около 97 през 2010 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the 'Публични инвестиции' (Public investments) line has multiple inaccuracies. While it starts correctly at 100, it rises to ~114 in 2008 before falling to ~98 in 2009 (not 75). The value in 2010 is about 92, not 97.

errors.text_span: Следва спад до около 65 през 2011 г., последван от период на колебания между 73 и 83 до 2014 г., достигайки най-ниска стойност от около 58 през 2016 г., след което се покачва до около 85 през 2018 година.
errors.evidence: This section describing the 'Публични инвестиции' (Public investments) line contains numerous errors and omits the most prominent feature. The value in 2011 is ~71. The line then rises dramatically to a peak of ~148 in 2015 (which is completely missed), then crashes to ~62 in 2016, and hits its lowest point of ~54 in 2017 (not 58 in 2016). The final value in 2018 is ~88 (close to 85).

The description fails to mention the most significant visual features of the chart, such as the sharp peak of 'Частни инвестиции' in 2008, and the extremely high peak of 'Публични инвестиции' in 2015 followed by a dramatic crash. It also misses the lowest point of 'Публични инвестиции' in 2017.
